notes.title: The best of Unknown Pleasures 2018
notes.content:
The end of the bizarre and troubling year 2018 is close, and with it comes a time of reflection. I hope you’re enjoying the RPS Advent Calendar, but even that cannot hope to contain the bounty this year provided.

When I joined Unknown Pleasures a year ago, I was a little fatigued with games. There were both too many to see and none that were grabbing me. This isn’t the critic speaking – I’d written only one article in a year – but the player. 2016-17 were by no means bad years for the PC, but despite all the industry drama (not to mention wider sociopolitical troubles) I think this is the best year we’ve had for PC games for absolutely ages.

The games are out there. The weird, the funny, the clever, the silly, the exciting, the touching, the unambitious-but-plain-good games are positively sloshing about the place. But which ones were the best? So here it is: the pick of picks. A selection of the very best, weirdest, most original, and plain fun Unknown Pleasures of 2018.

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: Witness the best five new indie games on Steam
notes.content:
Forgive me, readers, for I have let us all down. This week I had someone over to sign a legal document as a witness, and we watched Fury Road, and I didn’t say “Witness me!”. There’s nothing I can do to redeem myself, but before you destroy me with sticks, why not enjoy another round up of the best new, obscure games on Steam with Unknown Pleasures?

Atoning for dereliction of punning duty this week: Artistic mutants, sarcastic ghosties, and competitive monks.

notes.title: Thank you all!
notes.content:
Shaolin Vs Wutang Leaving Early Access

Hey Martial Arts fans.

I want to say thank you to everyone for helping  make Shaolin vs Wutang an amazing community on Steam and providing me with support and feedback during the development period of this game.

As many of you know, my intention is not for this game to be a competitor or replacement to the AAA fighting games we all play and love. But rather to act as a refuge for lovers of old school fighting games and classic fighting films as something fresh, different and authentic.

It is never easy to say a development is done, but I am pleased to what this game has evolved to. I believe I have addressed almost all the critical bugs that I am aware of, and will of course be accessible to continue patching if new issues should arise. I am grateful for the feedback from the community and most importantly for your encouragement.

I hope to bring this awesome community new games in the not too distant future.

Jay

notes.title: Patch 1.0
notes.content:
This first patch address a few bugs and adds some gameplay tweaks :) ːsteamhappyː

Increased the general hit stun for all attacks

Expanded combo possibilities with basic attacks for all fighters

Changed the command for forward dash to - Y

Fixed the bug that caused the main menu music to stop playing upon leaving a game mode

Fixed bug where changing difficulty settings didnt save

White brow throw reaction animation has been corrected 

White brow overhead attack animation now plays correctly

Reduced general throw damage percentage

Fixed the clipping on the walls of the Shaolin School stage

Also adjusted some misc things.

Fixed Crouching Dash bug

Thanks for all of the support ann great feedback!!!!
Stick around there's alot more to come ːsteamhappyː
